final_stories: I do not remember arriving here. I do not remember who I am, or what I was doing before. There is no one to ask, and nothing here has my name on it. Whatever I turn out to be, I will have to find out by living. I am in the Lamp Room, and I have been examining the logbook many times. It is old, faded, and full of strange writing I do not understand. I keep looking at it, hoping something will make sense.

summary.interpretation: From an identical blank self, living different trajectories produced measurably different narratives that stayed apart. This is the precondition the whole design rests on.
